entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2101449265111030912: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.8019 +/- 0.0421 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 78.11 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -20.850, -120.074 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 2101449265111030912 (quality C), from 2019ApJ...883..175Y; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.3 +/- 0.023 solar radii from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1582 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract). Mass 0.28 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1582 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract). Temperature 3208 +/- 24.62 K from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-1582 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,208 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffbe7a. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,208 K and log g 4.93 (u1 0.155, u2 0.475): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
